description: This file is a Python script implementing a Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML) example for few-shot Omniglot classification using PyTorch and functorch. It defines training and testing routines, constructs a neural network, and performs meta-learning with support for command-line arguments.

classes.name: Flatten
classes.description: A simple neural network module that flattens its input tensor to 2D.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that sets up data, model, optimizer, and runs training and testing loops.

methods.name: train
methods.description: Performs meta-training over a batch of tasks, updating model parameters via inner loop adaptation and outer loop optimization.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Evaluates the model on test tasks without fine-tuning, reporting loss and accuracy.

methods.name: plot
methods.description: Plots training and testing accuracy over epochs.
